title: Reclassify land cover and protected status to a common scale (mountain lion corridors)
method: Lookup-table reclassification of NLCD land cover (16 classes + 255) and protected status (0-4 + 255) to the 1-10 cost scale given in the task, each output value depending only on the original cell value; write uint8 GeoTIFFs on the input grid (NAD83 / UTM 11N, 30 m).

key_parameters.unmapped: land-cover value 0 (2.1 % of cells, outside the NLCD footprint) is not in the table; written as NoData (0) - any convention accepted

benchmark_defects: Land-cover value 0 (160 768 cells) is not covered by the given table; the task does not say how to treat it.
Dataset Description names the file 'dataset/landcover.tif' while the file is 'landCover.tif' (case).
checks: required: land cover output on the input grid (same CRS, shape, transform within 1 m)
required: land cover output equals the given table on >= 99.5 % of cells whose input value is in the table, and within every tabulated input class
required: protected status output on the input grid
required: protected status output equals the given table on >= 99.5 % of mapped cells, and within every tabulated input class
